holding_rationale: We hold 73 shares in Zerodha at an average cost of ₹4,405.35 (₹3,21,590.58 total). At the 23 November 2026 NSE close of ₹4,010.60 (live 25 November TV close ₹4,010.80), the stake is worth ₹2,92,773.80. That is an unrealised loss of ₹28,816.78 (-8.96%) and a 6.87% portfolio weight. Pass 1 forensics flagged heavy working-capital burn (₹766.7 Cr of QIP cash used in 40 days), 268-day GCA, and a 26x YoY jump in Q2 finance costs to ₹23.8 Cr. Top-5 customers and top-3 suppliers each reach 65–70%, while 27 PLI 2.0 rivals narrow the moat. Meanwhile, H2 FY27 implies a 13.3% sales step-down and the promoter lock-up ends in Feb 2027. The chart is in Stage 4 (-4.90% below the 200-day SMA) with -2.0% expected return. New capital is REJECTED (TIER_0). We shift to EXIT_ON_BOUNCE on all 73 shares: sell 43 shares at ₹4,217.26 (200-day SMA) and 30 shares at ₹4,440.99 (50-day SMA). Underneath, we raise our weekly-close hard stop from ₹3,703.75 to ₹3,716.48 (-7.34% risk vs +5.1% to +10.7% bounce zone).
